description: Kotlin Multiplatform SDK for over-the-air translations from the Tolgee Platform: Android Views integration (context wrapper, resource-id lookups), Jetpack Compose and Compose Multiplatform helpers, CDN loading with caching and BCP 47 locale fallback.
rules: Maven coordinates: io.tolgee.mobile-kotlin-sdk:core (Android Views / plain Kotlin) and io.tolgee.mobile-kotlin-sdk:compose (Jetpack Compose, Compose Multiplatform; includes core). Resolve the version from Maven Central.

Initialize once in Application.onCreate() with Tolgee.init { contentDelivery { url = "https://cdn.tolg.ee/<prefix>"; storage = TolgeeStorageProviderAndroid(app, BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE) } }; never in an Activity, Fragment or composable.
The Content Delivery must use the 'Android SDK' (JSON) export format; the default path is "$it.json" and the default formatter is Tolgee.Formatter.Sprintf. The SDK cannot parse strings.xml.

Android Views: override attachBaseContext(TolgeeContextWrapper.wrap(newBase)) in every Activity so getString and XML layouts resolve through Tolgee; outside Activities use context.getStringT(...) or Tolgee.instance.t(context, R.string.key, args).

Compose: import stringResource, pluralStringResource and stringArrayResource from package io.tolgee instead of androidx.compose.ui.res; they fall back to bundled resources when Tolgee is not initialized.
Keys are Android resource entry names (R.string.welcome_message -> welcome_message); keep strings.xml as the offline fallback.
Translations load asynchronously: call preload(lifecycleOwner) or collect tFlow/changeFlow; setLocale() alone does not fetch.

Task recipes for agents: https://docs.tolgee.io/android-sdk/agents (Markdown index https://docs.tolgee.io/llms.txt); API reference for agents: https://tolgee.github.io/tolgee-mobile-kotlin-sdk/llms.txt.
